description: WP 2.5: the Kotlin CLI per argv/inputs/environment, stdout, stderr and exit status after normalisation

schema.files: input files (path relative to the working directory -> UTF-8 content)
schema.modes: octal modes to set after creating the inputs
schema.env: variables added to HOME, TMPDIR and PATH (and JAVA_HOME for the Kotlin build)
schema.deviation: null, or the approved deviation that changes this row for Rust
schema.rust: null, or the Rust expectation (stdout, stderr, exit) where 'deviation' applies

normalisation: D12: the SLF4J(I) provider line is removed
D12: stack frame lines (\tat ..., \t... N more, \t... N common frames omitted) are removed
the sandbox working directory, given and canonical spelling, reads <SANDBOX>
a leading HH:mm:ss.SSS log timestamp reads <TIME>
D12: the identity hash after VersionCommandCliConfiguration@ reads <HASH>
the version in 'Starting marathon v<version>,' and a stdout line that is exactly the version read <VERSION>

D1: the reporter line ('Noop exceptions reporter started' in Kotlin, the unsupported-reporting line in Rust) reads '<TIME> [main] INFO  <D1>'; Kotlin's 'Noop exceptions reporter finished' line is removed
